decisions.decision: Expose the current LLM/news output only as a sentiment index; do not label it a directional XRP forecast, probability or price target.
decisions.reason: emit_signal.py has no explicit horizon/target and does not ingest market structure; latest score 44 resulted from provider failure plus news-score blending.

decisions.decision: Keep the 45.9% legacy summary NOT_COMPARABLE unless its exact 1,683 input records and evaluator version are recovered and reproduced.
decisions.reason: Current web/signal_history.jsonl is empty while the summary claims 1,683 checked signals.

decisions.decision: Treat HRM agreement×convergence as a heuristic feature/abstention measure, never as calibrated forecast probability.
decisions.reason: No trained weights, probability calibration or production integration are present in the inspected code.

decisions.decision: Use the new fixed_horizon_forecast_v1 schema for any future issued prediction: immutable data cutoff, explicit 1h/4h/24h/7d horizon, forward-return target and ex-ante neutral band, assumptions, alternatives/disconfirming evidence, calibrated up/down/neutral probabilities, confidence/calibration metadata, source/feature snapshot IDs, model commit, baseline comparisons, walk-forward/leakage audit and later outcome.
decisions.reason: The current production signal is sentiment-only and the existing accuracy evaluator used variable elapsed horizons.

decisions.decision: Forecast records must be shadow-only; no live execution field is permitted in the v1 contract. Do not issue a directional forecast until out-of-sample baselines and calibration pass.
decisions.reason: No fixed-horizon outcome labels, walk-forward results or calibrated probability evidence is currently verified.

decisions.decision: Track the manual Knowledge Signal Cycle as a separate main-write capability; do not describe PR #1379 as eliminating all main writers.
decisions.reason: The workflow is workflow_dispatch-only but grants contents:write and pushes directly to main.
